title: Super Activation Redesign
creator: colbymaloy
summary: Reimagining Super activation as a transition into a temporary altered combat state rather than simply triggering an ability. The HUD contracts, the weapon dissolves into energy, and the environment reacts to the Guardian rather than the other way around.
takeaways: The HUD physically reorganizes around the Super instead of swapping an icon
The weapon transitions into energy rather than disappearing
A Super should feel like entering another state, not pressing another button

directions.title: Direction A — Energy Manifestation
directions.note: The Light arrives from outside the Guardian and collects around them.

directions.title: Direction B — Weapon Overcharge
directions.note: The Super grows out of the equipped weapon instead of replacing it.

explorations.process: Prompted for a first-person ability activation with the HUD reacting before the effect fires.
